integrity_note: Proof is self-contained modulo standard Gauss-sum and quadratic-character identities, and independent finite enumerations are supplementary rather than exhaustive across all primes. External independent audit and absolute publication-priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three distinct erasures in the full normalized prime-dimensional Alltop Gabor orbit. Does not cover p=3, composite dimensions, arbitrary windows, more deletions or nonlinear phase retrieval. The p=5 numerical value was already reported in the motivating paper.
title: Sharp three-erasure stability of Alltop Gabor frames
